subtitle: Out Manila · Xiamen Airlines
overview: This 6-day no-shopping tour flies Xiamen Airlines from Manila to Fuzhou, then travels by themed sightseeing train and coach through Shangrao, Quzhou and Wuyuan. Highlights include Lingshan, Wangxian Valley and Huangling, the terraced village famous for its autumn colours. You return to Fuzhou by bullet train for a walk through Three Lanes and Seven Alleys before flying home. Hotels are 4-star, with 5-star in Wuyuan.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Nov 25–30 2026 to Mar 26–31 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Magnificent Shangrao Themed Sightseeing: A themed train to Shangrao with dance and music performances, activities, stamp collecting and a snack gift pack.
placeDesc.Lingshan: A scenic mountain near Shangrao, reached by cable car and a 10-section sky escalator.
placeDesc.Tian Kong Zhi Jing: A photo stop where a mirror-like water surface reflects the sky, giving the 'sky mirror' look.
placeDesc.Wangxian Valley: A valley scenic area with a cliffside village styled like a fairy-tale fantasy world; ticket included.
placeDesc.Root Palace Buddhist Culture Tourism Are: A Buddhist-themed cultural tourism area in the Quzhou region built around root-carving art; ticket included.
placeDesc.Changtai Maple Leaf Garden (Nov–Dec): A maple garden near Quzhou that replaces the Root Palace stop in November and December for autumn colours.
placeDesc.Shuitingmen Historical and Cultural Bloc: A restored historic riverside street in Quzhou with old-style buildings and shops.
placeDesc.Huangling: A hilltop village in Wuyuan known for its terraced rooftops of drying crops; ticket and cable car are included.
placeDesc.Wunvzhou Resort: A scenic resort area in Wuyuan along the river, visited with a ticket included.
placeDesc.Three Lanes and Seven Alleys: A historic old-town quarter in Fuzhou with traditional houses, lanes and pedestrian streets.
